```yaml
name: PR Closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gh

      - name: Close stale PRs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          THRESHOLD=$(date -d '30 days ago' +%s)
          echo "Threshold epoch: $THRESHOLD"

          PRS=$(gh pr list \
            --state open \
            --limit 1000 \
            --json number,author,createdAt,labels \
            --jq '.[] | select(
                    .createdAt | fromdateiso8601 < $threshold
                    and .author.login != "jdx"
                    and (.labels | map(.name) | index("keep-open")) == null
                  ) | .number' \
            --argjson threshold "$THRESHOLD")

          if [ -z "$PRS" ]; then
            echo "No stale PRs to close."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Stale PRs to close: $PRS"

          for PR in $PRS; do
            echo "Closing PR #$PR"
            gh pr close "$PR" --comment "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. Reopen by commenting or opening a new PR."
          done
```
